pcs.pc_description: Conduct research to identify relevant data analytics, data warehousing, and data management tools available in the market.
Evaluate tools features, capabilities, and suitability for the warehouse's requirements.

Assess the strengths and weaknesses of different tools and technologies after considering technical factors such as scalability, performance, ease of use, integration capabilities, and compatibility with existing systems.

Prepare a report with SWOT analysis of each of the shortlisted tools. Present the report to stakeholders and conduct meeting to finalize the tool after considering the organization's budget, long-term data requirements, and the skillset of the data team.
Evaluate ETL tools that facilitate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes to ensure that data is prepared and made available for analysis.
Evaluate statistical analysis software that can be used to perform advanced analytics and predictive modelling on warehouse data.
Investigate business intelligence tools that enable ad-hoc querying, reporting, and data exploration for better decision-making.
Ensure that the selected tools comply with data security and governance requirements, especially when dealing with sensitive or confidential data.
Evaluate how well the chosen tools can integrate with the organization's existing IT infrastructure and data management systems.
Conduct testing and proof of concept projects to validate the effectiveness and compatibility of the selected tools in the warehouse environment.
Coordinate training sessions for the data team to ensure they can effectively use the chosen tools for their data analysis tasks.
Ensure effective transition of tools to the vendor and responsible stakeholders.

pcs.pc_description: Gather historical sales data, customer orders, and any other relevant data sources from the warehouse management system, or enterprise resource planning (ERP) system.

Clean the data to remove any inconsistencies, errors, or missing values. Preprocess the data to make it suitable for analysis, such as aggregating it into relevant time periods (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly).
Analyse past demand patterns to identify any seasonal trends, cyclic patterns, or significant events that might have affected sales to form the basis of forecasting model.

Select appropriate forecasting methods based on the demand analysis and the characteristics of your data. Common methods include time series forecasting techniques like moving averages, exponential smoothing.

Use the selected forecasting method(s) to generate future demand forecasts for each product or product category in the warehouse. These forecasts will serve as estimates of the inventory needs in the upcoming periods.

Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to gather insights into upcoming promotions, new product launches, or any other factors that could impact future demand. Incorporate these insights into forecasting model.
Analyse the lead time for each product to understand the time it takes to replenish stock once an order is placed. Incorporate this lead time information into inventory forecast calculations.
Gather relevant data from various sources such as warehouse management systems, sales records, customer orders, and other related databases.
Gather historical sales data, SKU-level information, inventory levels, seasonal factors, and any other relevant data.
Cleanse and preprocess the collected data to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Cleanse and identify missing values, removing outliers, standardizing units, and transforming data into a suitable format for analysis.
Identify seasonal demand patterns and trends to understand how demand varies throughout the year.
Analyse inventory levels and turnover rates to optimize stock levels and reduce carrying costs while ensuring product availability to meet demand.
Continuously monitor demand patterns and forecast accuracy to assess the effectiveness of the implemented strategies and models.
Collaborate with other teams, such as supply chain management, sales, marketing, and finance, to align demand forecasts with business strategies and plans.
Conduct ad-hoc analyses based on specific questions or requests from management or other stakeholders.
